summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skipped on legacy Windows), test_control.py (test_control_title), test_windows_renderer.py (mocked set_title assertion). CHANGELOG.md gains one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Open points: with TERM=dumb, control() drops output silently, so set_window_title can return True with nothing written (following the spec's terminal-check-only rule); the changelog URL https://github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200 was inferred from the repo name and needs confirmation.
